executionArgs.additionalInstruction:
The backend runs on port 3001 at http://localhost:3001. CRITICAL instructions for test generation:

1. ALL game types must be UPPERCASE: "DICE", "LIMBO", "COINFLIP", "WHEEL", etc.
2. For ALL authenticated requests, first register a unique test user via POST /api/auth/register with unique username/email/password, then use the Bearer token.
3. Bet object ID field is "_id" (underscore prefix, from MongoDB/Mongoose), NOT "id".
4. For autobet tests, add balance first via POST /api/wallet/add with {currency: "USD", amount: 5000}.
5. For strategy tests, first GET /api/strategy/defaults to find preset strategy IDs (look for name field matching "Martingale", "D'Alembert", "Delayed Martingale").
6. For custom strategy creation, use POST /api/strategy with proper condition schema: {id: "c1", type: "bet", betTrigger: {frequency: "every", value: 1, target: "losses"}, action: "increase_bet_amount", actionValue: 100}
7. Autobet start requires config.numberOfBets to be >= 0 (0 = infinite).
8. onWin/onLoss objects need {reset: boolean} at minimum.
9. For DICE gameParams always use {target: 50, isOver: true}.
10. Wait between autobet start and checking results - use time.sleep(5) to time.sleep(15) depending on numberOfBets.
11. Session games TOWER, STAIRS, HILO, BLACKJACK must return 400 when used with autobet.
12. Bet history response is { bets: [...] } where each bet has _id, amount, gameType, isAutoBet, status fields.
